name: Cain Firesong
summary: At the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Cain Firesong guides Forsaken mages in the arcane. He trains them in Tirisfal Glades before sending advanced students to the Undercity for deeper study.

sections.title: A Practitioner in Brill
sections.body: Cain Firesong teaches traditional arcane arts in Brill, where Forsaken mages begin their studies. Many Forsaken spellcasters turn to shadow or necromancy, but Cain keeps to the arcane. He mentors mages who set out from Deathknell. The Deathguards point visitors to the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern, where Cain can be found. They joke that he arrived too late to get a room.

sections.title: Guiding New Talent
sections.body: Cain sends capable students onward when they outgrow their first studies in Tirisfal Glades. He directs them to Anastasia Hartwell, a master sorceress who lives in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

faq.answer: Cain Firesong trains Forsaken mages in Brill, in Tirisfal Glades. He teaches them arcane spells and directs advanced students to continue their studies in the Undercity.

faq.q: Where does Cain Firesong stay in Brill?
faq.answer: Cain Firesong can be found on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. The local Deathguards joke that he arrived too late to get a room.

faq.q: Where does Cain send mages after their initial training?
aliases: who does cain send mages to
faq.answer: Cain sends mages who advance under his guidance to the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where Anastasia Hartwell continues their instruction.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage setting out from Deathknell, you can learn the arcane from Cain Firesong in Tirisfal Glades before continuing your studies in the Undercity.
As an Undead, you can wield the arcane traditions of former human magi as a weapon for the Forsaken.
